title: Order of complete whole forms changes the downstream state
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED. Two complete passages use the same bound operations and participants in different orders. A directed whole-form composition predicts that the intermediate state entering the final operation changes with order, so the same final form has different justified recipients or outcomes.

design.mechanism: noncommutative whole-form state transformation with a downstream diagnostic
design.structural_basis: GDT608 shows that order and whole-form identity retain information beyond component rules; GDT747 shows complete local series can constrain an unresolved whole without exporting component meanings.
design.passage_contract: Nominate two complete source-bound records with the same finite operation inventory, at least two shared whole forms, and a fixed final operation. The source must independently establish that swapping the first two operations changes the final input or result.
design.prediction: For the target series, the first two complete forms in order A→B versus B→A must yield distinct downstream role cards for the same final form, while the shared whole meanings and participant inventory remain fixed. Order is evaluated over complete groups; no EVA/BPE character receives a meaning.
design.smallest_test: Find a pair of already exposed complete passage series with an independently known order contrast. Freeze the two orderings, final operation, and role mapping. Score only the final recipient/result relation, with a bag-of-wholes control and a same-order repeated-series control.
design.strongest_likely_failure: The order contrast is an artifact of line position, source segmentation, or a hidden context variable; the final form may simply carry one fixed value regardless of the preceding order.
design.falsifier: Reversing the first two complete forms leaves the same downstream role in held cases, or bag-of-wholes controls explain the result equally well, or source passages do not independently distinguish the two orders.
design.source_binding: Required: a complete historical or technical account where identical operations in two orders have explicitly different intermediate or final consequences. Target-only local plausibility is insufficient; no Latin/Rosetta default is allowed.
prior_distinctions: IDEA000365 tests a shared-property computation, not order-swapped downstream state
GDT910 tests short/long contextual substitution and is closed
GDT914 tests one-edit patterns and is closed
IDEA000307 is a raw formation-order versus flow lead without this fixed final diagnostic
design.access: Already admitted exposed sources only; f84, f84r, f116v and reserves remain closed. No new target content should be opened for this raw nomination.
design.selection_status: raw_unreviewed; no target fit, translation, or semantic confirmation claimed
